def prime_num(n: int) -> bool:
    """Check if an integer n is a prime number."""
    
    # Handle base cases
    if n <= 1:
        return False
    
    if n == 2 or n == 3:
        return True
    
    # Eliminate even numbers and multiples of 3 early on
    if n % 2 == 0 or n % 3 == 0:
        return False

    # Check divisors from 5 up to sqrt(n) using the pattern (6k ± 1)
    i = 5
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0 or n % (i + 2) == 0:
            return False
        i += 6
    
    return True


# Test as requested in the prompt
if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert prime_num(13) == True, "Test failed for input 13"

# Additional quick tests to ensure correctness
print(prime_num(1))   # False
print(prime_num(2))   # True
print(prime_num(4))   # False
print(prime_num(97))  # True
